text:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — hit a weird quota edge on dedicated yesterday. Tenant A has a 500 rps reserved pool, they sent a 900 rps burst for ~30s and we let ~300rps through from the shared capacity, but then latency for everyone jumped.
Ajay Patel: Hmm — is that the case where burst credits are unlimited until global pool is drained?
Maria Chen: Looks like it. The code path in the limiter checks reserved+burst, but burst is effectively 'use what’s free' without a bounded bucket. We saw eviction churn on other tenants when shared nodes filled KV caches.
Kevin Liu: Can you paste the limiter config you used?
Maria Chen: Sure, snippet from the tenant config we saw: 
```json
{
  "reserved_rps": 500,
  "burst_enabled": true,
  "burst_policy": "best-effort",
  "burst_window_secs": 60
}
```
Priya Rao: "best-effort" is the culprit — it doesn't reserve any per-tenant burst quota. It only checks global free capacity. For Dedicated we promised tenant isolation; that model breaks if a single tenant can eat all free slots.
Ajay Patel: Agreed. We should have a bounded token bucket for burst credits per-tenant. e.g. allow up to X% of reserved per burst window or a fixed credit pool. That keeps the shared pool for others.
Kevin Liu: Implementation-wise we can do a two-stage check: 1) allow if within reserved_rps; 2) else check tenant_burst_tokens.consume(1) — tenant tokens refill at rate r where r = reserved_rps * burst_refill_ratio. If tokens empty, fall back to global fairness queue.
Maria Chen: Yeah that lines up. Also we need to avoid a scenario where global fairness queue still lets the tenant in while tokens are empty. We should prefer global fairness only after tenant burst tokens are exhausted AND global capacity remains for fairness allocation.
Priya Rao: Another thing — telemetry is lacking. Operators couldn't tell whether the extra throughput used "burst credits" vs "shared pool consumption". We need metrics: tenant.burst_tokens_remaining, tenant.shared_capacity_consumed, and an event log when we transition to global fairness.
Ajay Patel: UX asks: console should surface current burst credit % and an indicator "Isolation at risk" when a tenant uses > reserved + 20% for > 15s. That'll help SRE/SEs preempt incidents.
Kevin Liu: Also worth adding a safety knob: emergency hard cap per-tenant = reserved_rps * hard_cap_multiplier (e.g. 2x). Overrides burst and global fairness. That prevents total starvation.
Maria Chen: Concern: hard cap may hurt legitimate sudden spikes (e.g., batch job warmup). Maybe allow override for admin keys with audit logs.
Priya Rao: Fine — admin override but it should require a TTL and write to audit log and console.
Ajay Patel: Action items: 1) change limiter to bounded tenant burst tokens (design PR) — Ajay will open. 2) Add three new metrics + event logs — Kevin will owner. 3) Console indicator + alert rule for "Isolation at risk" — Priya will spec. 4) Telemetry dashboard experiment to show before/after for a few Dedicated clusters — Maria will run tests.
Maria Chen: I'll spawn a quick repro script that simulates a 3-tenant storm to validate eviction behavior, attach to the PR.
deploy-bot: NOTE: rate-limiter-service v2.14-deploy queued for staging at 2026-07-18T18:02:00Z
infra-bot: FYI: creating ephemeral dashboard chart: dedicated.cluster-3.tenant_burst_test — link: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd123/dedicated-burst?orgId=1
Ajay Patel: I'll add proposed config fields in the PR: 
```yaml
tenant_burst:
  enabled: true
  max_tokens: 1000 # absolute credits
  refill_per_sec: 8 # how many tokens per second
  hard_cap_multiplier: 2.0
```
Priya Rao: Let's also add a rollout plan: staged for 10% of Dedicated hosts, monitor latency P95, eviction_events count, and tenant_burst_token_saturation. Roll forward if delta < 5% and eviction_events drop.
Kevin Liu: SGTM. I'll sketch the metrics names: `redwood.tenant.burst_tokens_remaining`, `redwood.tenant.shared_capacity_used`, `redwood.dedicated.eviction_count` and an event tag `policy=burst_token_exhausted`.
Maria Chen: Perfect. Thanks all — will open the issue/PR with logs and the repro tomorrow.
Ajay Patel: Thanks — will ping when PR is up. :thumbsup:
